[[File:Tele Group Ice Plateau icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Tele Group Ice Plateau''' teleports the caster along with anyone within a 3x3 square area (including standing on the player's square) to the [[Ice Plateau]] in level 53 [[Wilderness]]. Before casting, it warns the player that they are about to teleport into the "Deep Wilderness" with an option to abort. Players must have [[Accept Aid]] turned on in order to be teleported by this spell.
